an7.60:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya.
an7.60:1.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho hoti. sīlavā hoti. bahussuto hoti paṭisallīno hoti. āraddhaviriyo hoti. satimā hoti. paññavā hoti.
an7.60:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyāti.
